labkit.ui.interaction.enablePopout

Add a context-menu action to copy an axes to a figure.

Syntax

labkit.ui.interaction.enablePopout(ax)

Inputs

ax
UI axes or axes handle to receive the "Open axes in new figure" context action.

Output

No return value. Mutates ax and graphics children in place. Safe to call after redraws.
